articleTitle: Abnormal Bleeding on Birth Control: When to Worry About Pregnancy
imageHeadline: Bleeding on birth control but tests say no?
imageSubtext: Here's what breakthrough bleeding actually means — and when to worry.
pinTitle: Abnormal Bleeding on Birth Control: When to Worry About Pregnancy
pinDescription: Breakthrough bleeding is one of the most common birth control side effects, but it's hard not to spiral when you've heard stories about people who didn't know they were pregnant. Learn what negative pregnancy tests really mean, why irregular bleeding happens months into your method, and when bleeding needs follow-up.

items.label: Negative test + dual methods = pregnancy very unlikely
Breakthrough bleeding can persist past 3-6 months
Ultrasound rules out structural causes & pregnancy
